A container has the shape of a right circular cone. The height of the container is $18\,\text{in}$ and the diameter at the top of the container is $12\,\text{in}.$ Water in the container is evaporating so that its depth, $h,$ is decreasing at a constant rate of $2\,\text{in/h}.$ Find the rate of the water volume decrease when the water depth is $9\,\text{in}.$ Do not round the answer.

Hint: Assume that the rate of decrease is positive.

The water volume is decreasing at a rate of
{{field-1}} ${\text{in}}^{3}/\text{h}.$
